summary: The stream route now opts out of Bun's idle timeout via server.timeout(req, 0), so a quiet pool no longer drops the SSE connection every ten seconds; a new server test proves the connection survives past it (verified it fails unfixed). The client marks the connection down on any stream error but only raises the banner after a four-second grace, cancelled by the next snapshot and cleared on reconnect. Full suite, typecheck, and build clean.
